name: superpowers
description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
one_liner: A structured playbook that makes an AI coding assistant stop and plan properly before it writes code, instead of rushing in and making a mess.
buyer: An independent dev-tooling consultant who helps small engineering teams adopt AI coding assistants without the chaos.
business_use_cases: A consultant sells a 1-day 'AI dev workflow setup' package that installs and configures this methodology for a client's team.
An agency bundles it into their standard onboarding for new clients who want AI coding agents without quality collapse.
A trainer builds a paid cohort course teaching engineering teams this spec-first methodology.

money_ideas.idea: One-off consulting engagement to set up the methodology and skills for a client's dev team
Paid cohort course or workshop teaching the methodology

steal_this: Package a one-day 'AI coding workflow audit + setup' offer and pitch it to one small dev team this weekend.
